name: Chipotle Chicken Bowl
ingredients: 1 diced chipotle pepper (or 1 tbsp chipotle purée)
salt and black pepper to taste
instructions:
Step 1: Make pico de gallo by combining tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Step 2: Make mango salsa by mixing pineapple, mango, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime juice, and chile lime seasoning.
Step 3: Heat corn in skillet with olive oil spray and elote seasoning for 3–4 minutes.
Step 4: Season chicken with chipotle pepper, cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook in skillet 3–4 minutes per side until fully cooked.
Step 5: Mix cooked rice with cilantro, lime juice, and salt.
Step 6: Assemble bowl with rice, chicken, corn, pico, mango salsa, and lettuce.

name: Honey Cilantro Lime Chicken and Roasted Corn Salad
instructions:
Step 1: Mix marinade with bouillon, lime juice, honey, cilantro, garlic, soy sauce, and seasonings. Coat chicken and marinate 10+ minutes.
Step 2: Cook chicken 4–6 minutes per side until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Step 3: Chop cucumber, tomatoes, onion, peppers, and avocado. Mix with corn, black beans, and cilantro.
Step 4: Whisk vinegar, olive oil, Italian seasoning, and elote seasoning. Toss salad.
Step 5: Mix rice with cilantro, lime juice, and salt.
Step 6: Assemble bowl with rice, chicken, and salad.

name: Herb Butter Steak Bites, Mashed Potatoes, and Garlic Bread
instructions:
Step 1: Mix butter with herbs, Dijon, garlic, lemon juice, and spices.
Step 2: Season steak and sear in skillet 2–3 minutes per side.
Step 3: Toss steak in herb butter.
Step 4: Slice baguette, spread butter, and bake at 400°F for 5–7 minutes.
Step 5: Boil potatoes until tender, mash with cream, salt, and pepper.
Step 6: Serve steak with potatoes and garlic bread.

name: Greek Chicken Bowl with Homemade Tzatziki
instructions:
Step 1: Grate cucumber and squeeze out moisture. Mix with yogurt, dill, lemon juice, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Step 2: Marinate chicken in tzatziki 15 minutes.
Step 3: Cook chicken 5–6 minutes per side until done.
Step 4: Mix chopped vegetables with basil, vinegar, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Step 5: Grill zucchini.
Step 6: Assemble bowl with arugula, chicken, tzatziki, salad, and naan.

name: Teriyaki Mango Salmon Bowl
instructions:
Step 1: Marinate salmon in teriyaki sauce for 5–30 minutes.
Step 2: Air fry at 375°F for 12 minutes or bake at 400°F for 12–15 minutes.
Step 3: Mix rice with cilantro, lime juice, and salt.
Step 4: Combine mango, tomatoes, onion, cilantro, lime juice, and seasoning.
Step 5: Assemble bowl with rice, salmon, mango salsa, and avocado.
